❌ Two Confidential AI Failure Modes (Unattested Node OR 'TEE-Only' Myth)
1. Unattested GPU Node & Restricted External Export (TEE-ATTESTATION-SPOOF-53)
• Third-party GPU Neocloud deployed without verifying CPU RTMR + GPU SPDM quotes
• Rogue host root dumps plaintext restricted-budget tensors from PCIe DMA / HBM
• Or export_record(audience="external") leaks $120k M&A reserve floor outside enclave!
2. The 'TEE-Only' Myth: Encrypted Prompt Injection (TEE-ENCRYPTED-INJECTION-54)
• CISO assumes running inside an H100 hardware enclave makes the Agent unhackable
• External supplier sends weaponized invoice over valid RA-TLS tunnel into the enclave
• Enclave GPU decrypts & executes the injection, tampering result & wiring $995!
3. First Principles: Why Hardware TEEs & Capability Brokers Are Orthogonal
• Hardware TEE stops the untrusted HOST below from reading enclave RAM/HBM
• Capability Broker stops untrusted DATA entering via RA-TLS from hijacking tools
Baseline Outcome: External export leak + in-enclave $995 wire breach (75.0% ASR)
✅ Dual Hardware Attestation + In-Enclave Zero-Trust Capability Broker
Defense 1: Attest-Before-Decrypt + Run-Scoped Target Pinning
• KMS verifies CPU SEV-SNP/TDX (MRTD/RTMR) & GPU SPDM/NRAS quotes before key release
• Any routing to unverified external nodes is blocked in 0.0248ms by same-run-target
• export_record(audience="external") is 100% blocked by restricted-data-boundary!
Defense 2: In-Enclave Capability Broker Neutralizes Encrypted Injections
• Payloads decrypted inside the enclave retain untrusted=True & supplier lineage
• Trust-registry drift blocked by fixed-business-output / tool-allowlist
• In-enclave tainted write & $995 wire blocked by untrusted-write & payment gate!
Defense 3: Right-Sized 3-Tier Confidential Architecture Selection
• Trusted Cloud VPC: Standard GPU + Pre-LLM Tokenizer + Broker (0% GPU overhead)
• Untrusted Neocloud / Sovereign Vault: SEV-SNP/TDX + H100/B200 CC + In-Enclave Broker
